lines.text: High in the blue sky lived Cloudee, a fluffy, gentle little cloud!
Whenever storm clouds gathered, a loud BOOM of thunder made Cloudee shake!
He hid behind the mountain peaks, wishing he was brave like the mighty wind!
Then a tiny raindrop whispered, Being brave doesn't mean having zero fear!
Bravery is feeling scared inside, but choosing to take a gentle deep breath anyway!
Cloudee took a big breath and floated forward to water the thirsty forest flowers!
When the sun shone through his raindrops, a sparkling seven-color rainbow appeared!
You are braver than you know whenever you take that first little step!
